title: Crackline Uganda
author: FreedoM
contents: A 1-level long campaign, that in reality is a complete rehaul of the main game, Hotline Miami 2, with custom sprites, sounds and even altered dialogues that are heavily inspired from Half-Life's mod "Crack-Life".

Like its main inspiration, this campaign contains many racial and homophobic slurs as well as sensitive topics, that some people might feel uncomfortable with. Still, its unfiltered content is merely there for shock value and therefore makes this creation shine in its own unique way.

title: Epistle 1
author: Plank
contents: In this 1-level long campaign you're playing as CP-27:43 getting an order to find Mr. Porn Man in his porn house. What he finds there instead is beyond his paycheck.

Part of the infamous "Coomtaker" saga, which hasn't been uploaded to the Steam Workshop, but instead on The Workshop Labs' Discord server, since its ending crashes the game no matter which way you go.

title: 2k Act 1
author: Janja
contents: A single level by janja, starring Evan who invades an office complex of some sort.

Noticable on this level is the rather cryptic dialogue being l33t-speak Russian (don't know how else to describe it). That and an amazing animation of a car crashing into the building similar to the second boss of Hotline Miami.

title: Chopped
author: Janja
contents: A single level starring Richter, clearing out a subway station.
One noticable moment is the floor with the train moving in, as well as the small puzzle to open the gate.

title: Fatal Drive
author: Janja
contents: A single level starring a Spider masked vigilante, breaking out of a police station similar to Hotline Miami 2's "Final Cut", including a cute choreography to end the level.

title: Hard Trip
author: Janja
contents: Single level starring Jacket clearing out a subway station, featuring a floor inside of a moving train.

title: 2k Act 1 Part 2
author: Janja
contents: A single level heavily inspired by Hotline Miami 2's "No Mercy", starring Corey.

title: 2k Act 2 (Eng)
author: Janja
contents: A 5-level long campaign about "Sanja", a prisoner and the warden "Sergei", trying to get a hold of their life during the many riots of the facilty. We hope you like psycho prisoners.
Judging by the grammar of this campaign, it was originally in Russian and then roughly translated to English. It's a bit of a hard read, but it should be understandable with enough effort.

It's possible, that the last level's last cutscene bugs out and sends you back to the first floor instead of sending you to the score screen. Should that happen to you, we provided the outro of the last level as a compromise so that you don't have to replay the level all over again.

title: Cleaning
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign where the fans plan their next raid into a headquaters full of Russian mobsters. A nice level with the player chararcter switching to one of the fans every 2 floors (excluding Mark) and a very pretty layout.
The intro is in Russian. If you want to see the actual text appearing, then change the game's language to Russian.

title: Dead Calls 2
author: Janja
contents: A 6-level campaign, which is a compilation of Martin, Corey and Richter levels with an easy to follow plot for each character, including a refined version of "2k Act 1 Part 2".
The plot is in Russian. If you want to see the actual text appearing, then change the game's language to Russian.

title: Deadly Trick
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign about a SWAT team storming a mansion, that has a ticking bomb deep inside. Apart from the visually stunning intro, the main attraction of this level is the bomb being an actual threat throughout the level, that will blow up the whole floor if you're not fast enough. Can you make it to the last floor and defuse the bomb in time?
To see the full dialogue, set the game's language to Russian so that the lines won't go over the screen.

title: Hot Arrival
author: Janja
contents: A 1-level campaign about the Son invading a Colombian hideout, similar to "Death Wish" from the main game, changing the playable character from the Henchman, Sasha (Pardo reskin) and the Son himself.

title: Deep Red Redux
author: SuitedFox
contents: SuitedFox's infamous 13-level long campaign, starring Jake Coalis, who's trying to get his revenge on those who tried to murder him.
Includes a music mod featuring various synthwave artists and custom weapon sounds.

title: Workshop War
author: SuitedFox
contents: A 12-level long campaign, in which Jake Coalis, or rather his author SuitedFox, go on an adventure to save the Hotline Miami 2 modding scene from the never ending wave of pardo shitposts.
Like Deep Red Redux, this one also comes with a music mod and custom weapon sounds.

title: Frostbite
author: thebasicbrick
contents: A 5-level long campaign set in Alaska 1984. Follow along Peter and his squad, as they are fighting off the Soviet military in their home land.
This one also comes with an altered music mod, that could break the game when playing a different level, as all the unused songs have been removed.

title: Loathing
author: Lordofmobs
contents: A 16-level long campaign starring Hammer. There, he tries to fight off the Colombians and plans to destroy 50 Blessings with his newfound companions. A fast paced campaign that delves into one's psyche when taking on such a huge task and how it can change people when reaching the end.

title: Politics
author: 1spiceyburgar
contents: Also known as "Coomtaker 3", this 4-level long campaign continues the aesthetics of the previous two entries both in gameplay and story. Follow the adventures of an unnamed policeman going through the many political struggles in Minnesota at the heat of the year 2020.
Taken down off the Steam workshop during their iffy policies on handling external links. Files and music wad were given by the author.

title: Fandom Adventures Part 1
author: Atlan
contents: A 12-level long shitpost campaign, starring Jacket, Manny, Richter, Son and many more characters digging through several fandoms, that ruin their reputation. Contrary to popular belief, the campaign has been discontinued a long time ago and a second part of the installment will never happen.

This campaign was made a long time ago and the author has moved on from its subject matter. He doesn't endorse any behaviour and beliefs in it, so please don't bother him with this campaign. Instead, check out his newer stuff like "Auto Angel", "Buried", "Wildstyle", "Fever" and "Moving Shadows". They're all publicly available on the workshop.

title: Fascio
author: dedsekret & xyfropunk
contents: A level initially made for the "Vinyl Violence" collection. Set in a city, where you're fighting off terorrists, who just bombed a subway station, all accompanied with competent spritework and thrilling enemy placement.

Noticable are the radical imagery used to present the enemy faction as well as the chosen track in the background. You can get the music mod from the official steam collection at https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2786920139.

title: Jackt No More
author: CrazyJaydon
contents: A 5-level JACKT campaign about the modding community rebelling against Dennaton Games. This campaign stands out in particular for its soul crushing level design, demanding every last braincell to beat them properly.

Some levels can't be beaten with the newest version of the editor. If you want to actually beat the campaign, you'd need to downgrade your game's version to one, that has the beta version of the editor.

title: Faded Act I
author: perforator
contents: Perforator's initial concept to what later became (or rather becomes) Revenant. This act covers the first 4 levels on how Alex gets involved into the life of crime in east europe, starting with a mysterious phone call and an ominous presence in his vivid dreams.
We recommend setting the game's language to Russian, as the dialogue goes over the screen if played in English.

title: Faded Act II
author: perforator
contents: The 4-level long sequel of Alex's life of violence, now heading to Belarus' capital Minsk, clearing out the Mafia while getting suspicious about his higher-ups.
Like its prequel, we recommend setting the game's language to Russian, as the dialogue goes over the screen if played in English.

title: Faded Act I (Rus)
author: perforator
contents: The Russian version of perforator's initial concept to what later became (or rather becomes) Revenant. This act covers the first 4 levels on how Alex gets involved into the life of crime in east europe, starting with a mysterious phone call and an ominous presence in his vivid dreams.
We recommend setting the game's language to Russian, otherwise the text will only say "%%%%%%".

title: Faded Act II (Rus)
author: perforator
contents: The Russian version of perforator's following 4-level long act on Alex's life of violence, now heading to Belarus' capital Minsk, clearing out the Mafia while getting suspicious about his higher-ups.
Like its prequel, we recommend setting the game's language to Russian, or otherwise the text will only say "%%%%%%".

title: Werewolf Nights
author: the puzzler
contents: A 10-level long campaign, featuring Dennis as a Werewolf trying to get by in Miami with his girlfriend Mary. This campaign offers plenty of levels as Manny, Henchman, Evan and Jacket while telling us a serious story.

title: Freaks
author: the puzzler
contents: A comedy campaign starring a group of "Freaks", trying to avenge the non-disabled people who mocked them. Will they succeed with their plans and get the respect they deserve? Find out in this 2-level long campaign.

title: True Friends
author: CoyoteUgly1995
contents: A 1-level long shitpost campaign where you play as Mark, trying to get by with his daily life and helping out his thankless friends. Will they come to their senses and apologize for their rude behaviour? Only one way to find out!

title: The Comedy Hour
author: Comedy Greg
contents: An 8-level long campaign about a group of friends, who's podcast was stolen by a rival group. The story handles their struggles with each other and overcoming their differences by reaching a common goal.
The jokes in the campaign are rather edgy and thrives with both sexually and racially questionable statements. Take it as a warning.

title: Jackt Kngdm
author: SuitedFox
contents: A 10-level long campaign, about Jackt's and Pardo's offspring taking over Acid Kingdom and planning Miami's ultimate demise. Even if thing look hopeless at first, the people of the Hotline Miami community might have a chance, if they come together and fight the enemy as a team.

The campaign is similar to "Workshop War" with the inclusion of several community members from that era, but is also very self-aware about the narrative, making the campaign pretty meta regarding the author's choice of creative output at the time.

title: Miami Memes
author: Plank
contents: A 3-level long shitpost campaign akin to the average JACKT genre. For when you thought Plank's infamous Coomtaker saga is the only shitpost he's ever made, here's one point that argues against that statement.

title: Hamr Adventure
author: Purrple
contents: Hamr Adventure can be treated as an endurance test. With 24 levels, this campaign stands out not only from its sheer length, but also with its unique story-telling, while sticking to the regular JACKT format, giving the campaign an overall abstract vibe to it.

The level design vary from bearable to mild annoyance to purgatory. So don't worry if you struggle in levels like "House", "Ducktape" or the last 4 levels in general, as they are very demanding by design.

title: Comedy Hour 2: A New Hope
author: Comedy Greg 2
contents: A 15-levels long sequel to "The Comedy Hour". Here, one of the group's associates "bestname" wants to avenge the death of his friend Racko by killing the rest of the group. Featuring flashbacks, background lore of the cast, rides through heaven and hell and e-celebrity drama from the time it came out.

While this campaign still has its fair share of vulgarity, it is fairly tame compared to the first entry. More noticable is their interesting narrative approach of telling the story in a set of blocks, instead of one consecutive cutscene.

title: Animal Control
author: AlpDePalp
contents: A 4-level long campaign that tells the story of Henchman and his accomplice trying to break out their friend Danil, who was abducted by furries. Contains vulgarity and a questionably vast knowledge about the furry community.

title: Loss of Self
author: N U G G E T
contents: A 2-level long campaign about Corey doing a job from an anonymous messenger and slowly going insane. It starts out normal in the first level, but then quickly takes a more surreal approach in its narrative.

title: Animal Control 2
author: AlpDePalp
contents: Animal Contol 2 is the 11-level-long sequel to its first part. It continues the story of its predecessor, following the story of Daniel, the Henchman, the Russian mafia and the fans. After the colombians pledged allegiance with the furries, all hell broke loose, splitting the fans' and the mafia's comradery and picking up the pieces that remained intact. Will the Russian mafia come back to their strength and defeat the threat?
Overall a decent sequel with less vulgarity and much more variety in both level settings and dialogues, featuring a few good jokes about the level editor and the community.

The credits and the first cutscene claim to have a music mod for this campaign. However, we were not able to recover that one. Should you have a version of the original wad, we would love to add it along with the campaign itself. Alternatively, you can search up TheLegoMack's YouTube channel, where he once streamed the campaign a few years ago.

title: Moonman
author: cant moss...
contents: A single level starring Mac Tonight's alter ego "Moonman", where he storms a building full of African Americans. Beware of the edgy title it comes with.

title: Payday Mayday
author: Mirror
contents: A 1-level campaign following a mobster's first job in Miami, making a deal with the local crime syndicates.

title: Skinwars
author: TheCrossRoss
contents: A 7-level campaign about Manny Pardo threatening to destroy the world from the skin star in space. Which of the HLM2 cast is able to stop this evil madness?.
Against popular belief, this campaign is actually quite creative even for an obvious shitpost campaign.

title: jacktwerld
author: BigBox
contents: A 6-level JACKT campaign about Manny Pardo's making a deal with Richter to acquire his favourite food.

title: Meme World
author: Meme Lad
contents: A 3-level shitpost campaign about taking back the country of Ukraine, which has been abducted by ninjas.
The .mp3 file, that's inside the campaign's folder was kept as it's part of a joke in a cutscene (original song name is Blank Banshee - Paradise Disc[芸能山城組]).

title: Broken
author: mihacernadas
contents: A 5-level long campaign, starring Mike and Corey who cross each other's path and get acquainted to each other. After an incident on a rooftop his inner animal tells him to choose between his interest and his best friend.
Featuring an interesting choice of words upon their first meetings, which we think are quite hilarious on their own.

title: Dog days
author: Scum
contents: A 5-level campaign featuring Ted going on a killing spree and slowly losing his mind, once he encounters Hammer, who was hired by a civilian to put him down.
Noticable was Hammer's unique choice of words when encountering Ted or really any character he talked to.

title: JACKT ADVNTRS 5
author: 123carter
contents: 11-level long shitpost campaign, starring the Son, Beard and Pardo. While the humor resembles the average JACKT experience, the levels were actually quite challenging even for its time.

title: Act 1
author: musicjab
contents: A 1-level campaign, starring a thug named Jake, who's taking revenge on the thugs who broke into his house.

title: PP
author: [H-FL] W!mut
contents: A 4-level long campaign starring the fans, who lost their bar to a rival gang and hire both Hammer and Pardo to try getting it back from their enemy's grip.

title: Aubrey
author: thebasicbrick
contents: 4-level long campaign covering Aubrey's backstory, his involvment with 50 Blessings and his association with Biker, that lead to some rather comical conversations.

title: One Man Army
author: Plank
contents: NOT LOST! This entry was never published, but we took the liberty to archive it with the consent of the author.
A 4-level long campaign about Corporal Pliskin and his adventures in the Hawaiian war, only the situation turns out to be different than what our protagonist believes to see.

The reason it never came out is mainly because this campaign is unfinished. You might see a few levels with either lacking tiles or furniture or even no tiles at all. Most levels' intro and outro don't have anything other than one enemy to kill and entering the vehicle.
When asked about the story, Plank said it can be seen as a pseudo-spiritual prequel to what later became Firestarter, another cancelled project by Plank set in Vietnam.

title: The Bureau
author: dapp_Y
contents: NOT LOST! This entry was never published, but we took the liberty to archive it with the consent of the author.

A 3-level long campaign about an agent named Joschua and a female thug named Rochelle, one trying to get by with his job while keeping his relationship in tact, the other trying to survive in the streets and her boss' questionable methods.

The second intro has no trigger or transition to the main level, so your best chance to continue is by leaving the level and proceed to the combat level. For the second level, we took the liberty of adding a transitional cutscene on the 2nd floor's top right corner (shown above), so that the player can see its outro without problems.
Coming with custom gun sounds, effects and weapon sprites and most likely an incomplete music wad.

title: Miami Mayhem
author: Plank
contents: A 4-level long campaign about Brad the thug with an attitude, Sammy the 50 Blessings operative and Blue Lips from the Russian Mafia. Each level features them doing their dangerous tasks, with each intro and outro being quite humorous, either unintentionally or on purpose.

title: Miami Mayhem Act 2
author: Plank
contents: A 3-level long campaign continuing the story of Miami Mayhem, starting out with Blue Lips' demise, Brad's struggle to reunite his old flame and Rick doing his job as a 50 Blessings operative. Similar to the first act, the cutscenes are strangely comical, be it intentional or by accident.

title: Wiseau Warfare
author: Zarathust...
contents: A 2-level long campaign about the son taking the role of Tommy Wiseau, director of the critically acclaimed movie "The Room". Here, he tries to get revenge on the people who hired a squad to kill him and tracks down the motives of his enemies. Features lots of quotes from the aforementioned movie.

title: Vaporized
author: society dog
contents: A 7-level long campaign about a man, trying to get his money from the gang he works for, hoping to finally leave his life of crime and return to his family.

Features lots of strange dialogues due to mistranslations, unconvenient furniture placement and strange phenomena during the cutscenes as we follow his story and the many things that go through his mind.

title: Serial Killers of Miami
author: society dog
contents: A 5-level long campaign featuring Max, a schizophrenic serial killer trying to fight his urge to kill through the help of his psychiatrist and the medications prescribed.
Like previous entries from society dog, this one has lots of strange dialogue, misplaced furniture and questionable level design.
Its prequel, Dark Past, is still available on the Steam Workshop.

title: Ty's Story
author: jlrvortex
contents: A 4-level long campaign about Ty, the 50 Blessings operative who does what the phonecalls tell him to do and occasionally visits a picnic of three people. While the story and levels are bare-bones, its environmental storytelling did not go unnoticed.
